prompt: A rectangular garden plot has an area of $198$ square feet. What is the area, in square yards, of this garden plot? ($1$ yard $= 3$ feet)
explanation: Choice A is correct. It's given that $1$ yard $= 3$ feet. Since area is measured in square units, $1$ square yard is equal to $(3 \text{ feet}) \times (3 \text{ feet}) = 9$ square feet. Therefore, to convert $198$ square feet to square yards, divide by $9$: $\frac{198 \text{ square feet}}{9 \text{ square feet per square yard}} = 22$ square yards.
